Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T12:12Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: map `top` / `bottom` to recharts `orientation` on every `<XAxis>` (state the horizontal-bar arm's mapping); `left` / `right` on an x axis gets a stated reading — a loud refusal naming the key, not silence.

Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5832163059
Serial constraints cleared: open-PR file lists read 2026-09-25T13:00Z: no open PR touches `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` or `plugin-charts.mdx`. PR objectui#10601 (this seat, in rework) touches only one `plugin-charts` test file, and it will not collide. `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test`: NOT GOVERNED.

`Clause-②: no` — the renderer begins honouring a key the spec already declares; no export, schema or accept set moves.
